interpretation_limits: YigL vitamin-B6 role is additional and conditional, not an exclusive replacement of sugar-stress function.
YihU SSA chemistry is retained despite stronger native SLA evidence; no universal claim that side activity is impossible in cells.
SuhB retained IMPase capacity; rRNA maturation role does not validate every detailed looping mechanism or cross-species transfer.
HFP native essentiality, comparative ARAPDP/FM N efficiency and exclusivity remain unestablished; RpiA contamination is author-reported.
FrsA physiological substrate remains unknown; positive model-ester chemistry does not settle it.
YjjG effects depend on supplied compounds, thyA background and medium.
No source-derived exact sequence activity rules adopted.
